key_concepts: Acids produce hydrogen cations in water and have pH below 7
Bases produce hydroxide anions in water and have pH above 7
Salts are ionic compounds that dissociate into cations and anions in water
Salts occur naturally and can be produced by chemical reactions
Indicators change color in acidic and basic solutions
Litmus paper is a solid indicator made from plant pigments
Natural, synthetic, and olfactory indicators are used to test substances
A pH meter measures whether a solution is acidic, basic, or neutral
The pH scale is used to classify solutions as acidic, basic, or neutral
Hydrochloric acid, sodium hydroxide, and saline solution are common examples of acid, base
Acids, bases, and salts form or dissociate in aqueous solution
